run_ipw_weighting: run inverse propensity weighting to compute sample weights that balance a sample distribution against a target distribution
run_ipw_with_custom_sklearn_model: run IPW with a custom sklearn classifier like RandomForestClassifier to compute propensity scores and reweighting
run_ipw_with_custom_formula: run IPW with a custom formula string to specify interaction terms and covariates for the propensity model
run_ipw_with_penalty_factor: run IPW with a penalty_factor list to apply different regularization penalties per covariate in the propensity model
run_ipw_with_na_action_drop: run IPW with na_action set to drop to remove rows containing missing values before computing weights
